name: retention
description: How long each class of evidence is kept, and what pruning is allowed to do to the manifest.

tiers.rationale: This is the record that the run happened and what it concluded
Enough to re-audit a migration through a typical audit cycle
Reproducible from their content hashes and the source URLs
Regenerable from the sealed snapshot and the checkpoint history

pruning.rationale: Dropping a reference so a later verification looks clean would defeat the purpose of the manifest. ARCHIVED and TAMPERED are distinct verdicts because absence is not the same as alteration.

sensitive_data: Nothing in any tier contains a plaintext sensitive value, so retention does not extend the exposure of one. See policies/security/sensitive-data-policy.json.
